# PostFader tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_tool_reference.py from fl_studio_mcp/mcp_server.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

PostFader gives your AI client **85 tools** and **8 resources** for FL Studio.
You never call them yourself: ask for what you want in plain language and
the AI picks the tools. Use this page to see what is possible, or to check
what your AI did.

21 tools can change the open project. Setters are refused until write mode
is on for the session; Production Runs and the palette, processing, and
revision apply tools turn it on themselves when you asked for changes.
PostFader never saves the project, and every other tool leaves it as it is.
Details: [security policy](../SECURITY.md) ·
[exact arguments and results](tool-contracts.md).

## Session and project

Write access, the project summary, undo history, and multi-target edits.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session_get_capabilities` | Report which FL Studio integration paths work in this bridge session. | No |
| `session_set_write_mode` | Turn write mode on or off for this bridge session without restarting FL. | Turns writes on/off |
| `project_get_summary` | Read the open project's metadata, counts, dirty state, and transport. | No |
| `project_get_history` | Read FL's undo history: position, count, next undo hint, and dirty state. | No |
| `project_step_history` | Undo or redo one step of FL Studio's project history and verify the move. | **Yes** |
| `project_apply_edits` | Apply edits you have already decided, across several targets, in one call. | **Yes** |

## Transport

Playback, recording, position, tempo, loop mode, and time signature.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transport_set` | Change playback, recording, tempo, loop mode, and other transport settings. | **Yes** |

## Mixer

Mixer tracks, levels, routing, sends, the built-in EQ, and peak watches.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mixer_list_tracks` | List mixer tracks with names, levels, mute/solo state, and loaded effects. | No |
| `mixer_get_track` | Read one mixer track's full state: level, pan, effects, EQ, and sends. | No |
| `mixer_set_track` | Change any combination of one mixer track's settings in one call. | **Yes** |
| `mixer_start_peak_watch` | Start sampling mixer peak meters while the user plays the song. | No (local state) |
| `mixer_get_peak_watch` | Read a peak watch's status and cumulative per-track peaks so far. | No |
| `mixer_stop_peak_watch` | Stop a peak watch early and return its final per-track aggregate. | No (local state) |
| `mixer_plan_gain_staging` | Propose dB fader moves that bring each watched track to a target peak. | No |

## Channels

Channel Rack channels, the step sequencer, and note audition.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `channel_list` | List every Channel Rack channel with its mix, routing, and generator. | No |
| `channel_set` | Change any combination of one Channel Rack channel's settings in one call. | **Yes** |
| `channel_get_steps` | Read one channel's step-sequencer grid in the current pattern. | No |
| `channel_set_steps` | Turn step-sequencer cells on or off for one channel in the current pattern. | **Yes** |
| `channel_play_note` | Play one short note on a channel so the user can hear the sound. | No (plays a note) |

## Patterns, Playlist, and automation

Patterns, Playlist tracks, section markers, and automation recording.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern_list` | List the project's patterns with name, color, length, and which is current. | No |
| `pattern_set` | Rename, recolor, resize, or select one existing pattern in one call. | **Yes** |
| `pattern_create` | Create a pattern: find the first empty one, select it, name it, and size it. | **Yes** |
| `playlist_list_tracks` | List every Playlist track with its name, color, and mute/solo/selection. | No |
| `playlist_set_track` | Rename, recolor, mute, solo, or select one Playlist track in one call. | **Yes** |
| `playlist_get_selection` | Read the Playlist's current time selection and the project PPQ. | No |
| `playlist_add_markers` | Add named section markers (Intro, Verse, Drop) to the Playlist timeline. | **Yes** |
| `automation_record_value` | Record one automation value into FL while playback and recording run. | **Yes** |

## Plug-ins and presets

Loaded plug-in parameters, presets, drum pads, and loading on macOS.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin_list_loaded` | List every loaded mixer effect and Channel Rack instrument as a target. | No |
| `plugin_list_parameters` | List a loaded plug-in's real controls with their current values and text. | No |
| `plugin_set_parameter` | Set one plug-in parameter by display value, option text, or raw 0..1 value. | **Yes** |
| `plugin_list_presets` | Read a page of a loaded plug-in's preset names, its preset count, and current preset. | No |
| `plugin_select_preset` | Load a known preset on one mixer effect or Channel Rack instrument. | **Yes** |
| `plugin_get_pad_map` | Read an instrument's drum pads: MIDI note, color, and empty/muted state. | No |
| `plugin_list_available` | List the instruments and effects in FL's native Add menu (macOS only). | No (local state) |
| `plugin_load` | Add one instrument (new channel) or mixer effect from FL's Add menu (macOS). | **Yes** |

## Effect processing

Turn processing goals into settings for loaded effects and apply them.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |

## Sound Selection

Choose and apply presets from the instruments already loaded.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sound_get_inventory` | Read the pool of loaded instruments and their presets that palettes choose from. | No |
| `sound_plan_palette` | Choose an instrument and preset for each musical role from loaded sounds. | No |
| `sound_get_palette` | Look up a previously planned sound palette by its palette_id. | No |
| `sound_apply_palette` | Apply the palette returned by sound_plan_palette, loading each role's preset. | **Yes** |
| `sound_record_feedback` | Record the user's explicit verdict on a palette so future picks follow it. | No (local state) |
| `sound_get_history` | Report the local sound-selection history: location, health, and record counts. | No |
| `sound_reset_history` | Delete the local sound-selection history after the user asks to. | No (local state) |

## Audio analysis

Measure exported audio files. FL Studio's live output is not available.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audio_analyze_file` | Measure one rendered file's loudness, peaks, spectrum, dynamics, and stereo image. | No |
| `audio_compare_files` | Compare a candidate render with a reference and suggest tonal adjustments. | No |
| `audio_analyze_masking` | Measure where an instrumental masks a vocal and suggest remedies. | No |
| `audio_diagnose_mix` | Diagnose a rendered mix against technical thresholds for a delivery target. | No |
| `audio_list_recent_bounces` | List the newest audio files in FL Studio's Rendered, Audio, and Projects folders. | No |
| `audio_estimate_tempo_and_key` | Estimate a file's tempo and major/minor key, with ranked alternatives. | No |
| `audio_transcribe_melody` | Transcribe a monophonic recording (a sung or played line) into notes. | No |

## Piano Roll

Read, write, and transform notes through FL's Piano Roll scripting.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `piano_roll_setup` | Prepare the one-time Piano Roll scripting setup that note tools need. | No (local state) |
| `piano_roll_read_notes` | Read the notes of one channel in one pattern: pitch, timing, and expression. | No (local state) |
| `piano_roll_write_notes` | Write notes into one channel's Piano Roll score in a pattern. | **Yes** |
| `piano_roll_transform_notes` | Quantize, transpose, humanize, duplicate, delete, or clear existing notes. | **Yes** |

## Production Runs

Multi-step jobs that PostFader validates and executes in order.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `run_describe_operations` | List Production Run operations and return exact schemas for the ones named. | No |
| `run_validate` | Dry-run a Production Run plan against the live project without changing it. | No |
| `run_execute` | Run a multi-step production plan, such as writing a chorus, as one task. | **Yes** |
| `run_continue` | Resume a stopped or blocked Production Run, or change its unexecuted remainder. | **Yes** |
| `run_stop` | Stop a run so no further operations execute. | No (local state) |
| `run_get` | Read a run's status, generated outputs, and per-operation receipts. | No |
| `run_list` | List recent Production Runs saved on this computer, newest first. | No |

## Creation Review and delivery

Review an exported draft, plan one revision, and prepare delivery.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `review_start` | Start a Review Session for the result of one completed Production Run. | No |
| `review_attach_assets` | Validate exported audio files and attach them to a Review Session. | No |
| `review_evaluate` | Measure an attached bounce as a whole and section by section, with findings. | No |
| `review_get` | Read a Review Session, its next export request, or its delivery manifest. | No |
| `review_compare` | Compare the bounces before and after a revision against its objective. | No |
| `review_plan_revision` | Compile one bounded revision plan from evaluation findings and feedback. | No |
| `review_apply_revision` | Apply the revision plan returned by review_plan_revision to the project. | **Yes** |
| `review_record_feedback` | Record the producer's explicit feedback and locks in a Review Session. | No (local state) |
| `review_stop` | Stop a Review Session so no further revision work happens. | No (local state) |
| `review_delete` | Delete one Review Session's stored record after the user asks to. | No (local state) |
| `review_export_delivery` | Write a Review Session's delivery manifest to new JSON or Markdown files. | No (writes a file) |

## Saved-project rendering

Render a saved .flp to WAV in a separate FL Studio process.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render_start_job` | Render a saved .flp to a WAV with FL's command-line exporter, as a background job. | No (local state) |
| `render_get_job` | Read a render job's status and, once ready, its decoded WAV details. | No |
| `render_cancel_job` | Cancel a render job: stop monitoring it and the process it started. | No (local state) |

## Resources

Clients that support MCP resources can read these for context. They follow
the same rules as the matching read tools.

| Resource | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `fl://capabilities` | Live verified capability report for the connected FL Studio bridge. |
| `fl://status` | Compact live connection, project, transport, and write-mode context. |
| `fl://project` | Live typed summary of the currently open FL Studio project. |
| `fl://transport` | Live playback, recording, loop, position, and tempo state. |
| `fl://mixer` | Live bounded mixer-track inventory without instantaneous peaks. |
| `fl://channels` | Live global Channel Rack inventory with stable target identities. |
| `fl://patterns` | Live pattern inventory, current selection, identity, and length. |
| `fl://plugins` | Live inventory of loaded mixer effects and Channel Rack generators. |
